# Alice

Protecting Generative AI Applications and Agents

Cyber Security

Private

## Company Overview

### Snapshot

Founded in January 2018 by Noam Schwartz, Alon Porat, Iftach Orr, and Eyal Dykan, Alice operates with 201–500 employees. The company has raised $100M across 3 funding rounds from 9 investors. In August 2026, Alice raised $140 million at a valuation of $700-800 million, indicating strong investor confidence in its AI security solutions.

### Business overview

Alice, formerly ActiveFence, specializes in providing trust and safety solutions to make the internet a safer place by eliminating harmful content. The company offers data, services, and software that enable trust and safety teams to manage complex operations, gain visibility into unwanted on-platform activity, and receive early warnings of threats. Its core technology leverages artificial intelligence to proactively handle various types of harmful content across different languages and formats, serving enterprises and content production within the media and entertainment sectors.

### Strategic signal

Alice's recent $140 million funding round in August 2026, at a valuation of $700-800 million, signals significant market validation for its pivot towards securing generative AI applications. This substantial investment, following its rebranding from ActiveFence, highlights investor belief in the critical need for a new security layer for AI, positioning Alice as a key player in this emerging and high-growth segment of the cybersecurity market.

## Company Intelligence Q&A

What was Alice's most recent funding round?In August 2026, Alice raised $140 million at a valuation of $700-800 million, emphasizing the growing demand for AI security solutions.

When did Alice acquire Spectrum Labs?Alice acquired Spectrum Labs in September 2023 to enhance its capabilities in fighting harmful content.

What was the strategic significance of Alice's acquisition of Rewire?In March 2023, Alice acquired Rewire to bolster its ability to help customers identify harmful text-based content, expanding its trust and safety offerings.

Has Alice undergone any significant organizational changes recently?In March 2025, Alice underwent a streamlining process that included laying off 22 employees.

What was Alice's previous name?Alice was formerly known as ActiveFence, and its rebranding was highlighted in June 2026 in connection with its role as a protective wall for Anthropic.

## Alice — full profile (machine-readable)

ActiveFence was established with the vision of making the internet a safer place by eliminating harmful content and, to that end, created a complete trust and safety solution. Providing data, services, and software that support trust and safety teams, the company allows platforms of any size to proactively handle any threat that reaches their door, no matter the type, language, or format.

ActiveFence has built a trust and safety tool stack that allows trust and safety teams to orchestrate their complex operations while gaining complete visibility of unwanted on-platform activity and early warning of oncoming threats.
